description: HCA Healthcare, Inc., operating through its subsidiaries, delivers a comprehensive array of healthcare services throughout the United States. The organization manages a network of general and acute care hospitals that provide a full spectrum of medical and surgical care,…
mda_take: FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-10): a record year - revenue +7.1% to $75.600B, net income $6.784B ($28.33 dil EPS vs $22.00), same-facility equivalent admissions +2.4% and revenue per equivalent admission +4.1%, salaries/benefits down to 43.5% of revenue and supplies 15.0%; $10.067B buybacks + $679M dividends. Consistent-or-better on the period, but the MD&A explicitly discloses 2026 headwinds: expiration of enhanced premium tax credits at end-2025, the 2025 Federal Budget Act state-directed-payment (SDP) limits, and an expected SDP revenue decline in 2026.
transcript_take: Q1 FY2026 call (2026-04-24): revenue +4.3%, adjusted EBITDA +~2% (margin -50bps), adjusted dil EPS +~11%; but volumes softened - same-facility admissions +0.9%, inpatient surgeries -0.3%, outpatient surgeries -1.7% - on a mild respiratory season (respiratory admissions -42%) and a January winter storm (~$180M combined EBITDA drag). A higher-than-expected supplemental-payment benefit (~$200M vs $80M expected, Georgia grandfathered approval + Texas Atlas reinstatement) mostly offset it and FY2026 guidance was reaffirmed. Real positives (EPS growth, reaffirmed guide, supplemental upside) against real negatives (surgery/margin softness, ~$150M exchange impact, looming eEPTC/SDP policy cliff).
